llm_response.reason: The website mimics the appearance of a legitimate fashion retailer and uses the 'NIKKIE' brand, but provides no company or contact information, has navigation almost exclusively to internal pages (cart, home), uses urgency and psychological trust phrases ('100% Veilig winkelen', 'SSL-codering', 'Gratis thuisbezorgd'), and no evidence of business legitimacy or online reputation can be found. These are distinctive markers of fake online shopping scams that exploit consumers with attractive but fraudulent offers.
